'''Pria's sole moon'''<ref name="Gamer8" /> was a part of the [[Pria system/Legends|Pria system]]. It was situated in the [[Arrowhead]] region within [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA Pria" /> It [[Orbit/Legends|circled]] the terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pria/Legends|Pria]] and maintained what its [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Priapulin]] [[Species/Legends|species]] referred to as a "perfect" orbit. As a result, by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]],<ref name="Gamer8" /> which began in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> a tidal cycle on Pria had for several [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] equaled nearly exactly ten [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]].<ref name="Gamer8" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pria's sole moon was introduced in "[[The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Priapulin|The Priapulin]]," a [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' source article in [[The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life (Star Wars Gamer)|''The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life'']] series. The article was published in the [[Star Wars Gamer 8|eighth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine<ref name="Gamer8" /> on [[December 21]], [[2001]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20011210.html|text=Yuuzhan Vong Invade ''Gamer'' #8}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Pria [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the moon, in grid square M-10.<ref name="TEA Pria" />
